card.name: Multi Purpose Wheel Incremental
card.description: Rotate everything in this new spin on the Incremental genre! Rotate satisfying contraptions to earn interconnected currencies. Upgrade the contraptions to earn more, earn faster, and earn whackier. Unlock new contraptions to expand your rotating horizons.

card.name: MUTINY!
card.description: MUTINY! is a multiplayer platformer fighter game that allows up to 10 players per round! Using different kinds of bombs and the power of physics, ensure your victory as the last man standing on pirate ships, treacherous waters, and other dynamic maps that aren't exactly on your side either.

card.name: Cornerwitch
card.description: Cornerwitch is a cozy idler game that sits on the corner of your screen. Study new spells and advance through a magical journey. Unlock cosmetics to dress up your little witch, level up and become stronger.

card.name: Car Wash Crew
card.description: Run a roadside car wash solo or with up to 3 friends. Blast mud, spread foam and build new bays by hand. Customers bring cars, buses, rugs—and the occasional house. Follow their tickets, split the work and try to keep your crew out of the soap.

card.name: Cartastrophe
card.description: CARTASTROPHE is a party game for 1–4 players, streamed live as the internet's most exciting death game. Crash, shoot and stab your way through minigames for likes, and survive the Final Showdown to walk out famous.

card.name: Magnet Fishing Together
card.description: A cozy co-op game about magnet fishing with up to 4 friends. Throw, pull and hope for something good. Sometimes it’s a rusty spoon. Sometimes it’s a scooter you can ride. And sometimes your friend lets go of the rope at the worst possible moment.

card.name: Sort the Bazaar
card.description: Sort The Bazaar is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort a variety of items and bring life and color back to a faded roadside market. Unlock new skills, automate tasks, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning a dull, messy bazaar into a vibrant, organized marketplace at your own pace.

card.name: One More Asteroid
card.description: Drill voxel asteroids apart in an incremental mining game. Grow from one drill to a swarm of drones that mine where you aim. Unlock powerful tools, crack the core and watch the asteroid collapse. Then take on the next, stranger rock.

card.name: Capture the Flag: Arcade Car Battles
card.description: Grab the flag and don't let go! Fast arcade car battles in a roaring stadium: campaign, 6-car free-for-all, 4v4 teams and Bring It Home goals, offline vs AI or online with friends. Boost, bump, dodge TNT and collect 15 cars. No ads.

card.name: Social Net
card.description: Incremental fishing in reverse: a fish catches people with money. Throw your net into the crowd, yank sunbathers out with the rod, hand in the catch, unlock the skill tree and new places - from a sunny beach to an icy bay and an ocean liner.

card.name: GUTTERGLOW
card.description: A bowling roguelike with real pin physics. Aim and throw, score points for every pin that falls, and build your ball with pins, tricks and upgrades until one throw multiplies into a huge score. Ten levels, twelve bosses that change the lane, three modes.

card.name: Quiet Bloom
card.description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

card.name: Loss Prevention: Prologue
card.description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

card.name: Idle Tides
card.description: Idle Tides is an idle incremental where your goal is simple: Catch as many fish as you can. Unlock new boats to automate your fishing, upgrade your fleet, and help the island with this fish overpopulation!

card.name: Orca Girl: Idle Fishing Story
card.description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

card.name: Island Keeper
card.description: Island Keeper is a cozy exploration and restoration adventure. As maintenance robot Ferrum-1, clean up a polluted archipelago, recycle rubbish into gear and stations, and watch every island turn green again as wildlife returns.

card.name: Cucumber
card.description: One cucumber. One space bar. Suddenly, a collection. Make your cucumber jump, collect designs through activity in the game, combine cucumbers through crafting and display your favourites. A free meme game with optional cosmetic shop items.

card.name: Tinsel Tumble
card.description: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

card.name: Gnomes Garden: Fairy Kingdom
card.description: The Gnome Queen uncovers the history of the fairies, restores friendship, and fights an ancient darkness.

card.name: Idle Raiders: Second Run
card.description: Idle Raiders: Second Run is an idle RPG about a band of pixel art heroes who farm, raid and loot on their own. You build their town, pick their gear, skills and AI, and send them out farming or into more than 25 raids. Version 2.0 of the browser classic from Pit Forest, rebuilt on a new engine.

card.name: I just wanted a marshmallow.
card.description: 'I just wanted a marshmallow.' is a casual completely normal take on the arena shooter genre. Falling into the pits of despair over not having a marshmallow, you and your crew opt to take the matters into their own hands. There's not much else to say about this game.

card.name: Best Dam Game
card.description: Chew trees, throw logs, blow stuff up. Best Dam Game is co-op physics chaos for up to 4 beavers building one seriously big dam. Take the contract, beat the rising river, fire your friends out of a cannon, and hunt down some very important hats.

card.name: Toy or Not
card.description: Toy or Not ? is an online hide-and-seek party game for up to 8 players. Sneak around as a toy, collect batteries, and rescue your teammates—or play as a kid, spot suspicious toys, and send them back to the toy box. Turn an ordinary room into a playground of sneaky tricks and surprises!

card.name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
card.description: An idle auto-battler that lives in a small window on your desktop. Spend the gold your party earns on fantasy packs, collect hero, monster and even boss cards, and field a party of four. They fight on their own while you work. Sweep your mouse across the field to leave a trail of fire.

card.name: TrapRush
card.description: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

card.name: $1 Pizza Slice
card.description: Run a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt one slice at a time.

card.name: Explosive Express
card.description: Explosive Express is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

card.name: Friendgeist
card.description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

card.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3
card.description: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.

card.name: Elf Raid!
card.description: Storm the castle with a band of brave little elves and rescue Fairycorn before Sir Grumblebottom marries her! Couch co-op for 1 to 3 kids aged 3 to 10: pick a boy or girl elf in your own colours, choose your own difficulty, and nobody gets left behind.

card.name: Monolith Zero - An Incremental Odyssey
card.description: A pixel art incremental game of mining and drones. "Captain, the mothership has lost control near an unknown structure. We're stuck. It's pulling iron-laden asteroids towards us… It seems to want to help us."

card.name: It's a Montage
card.description: A pixel-art training game with no opponents, where every level you gain shows on your character and the world around you. Once you outgrow the dojo, you train at a waterfall, on the open sea, on the moon, on a star and at the edge of a black hole.

card.name: Re-Ball
card.description: A first-person hyper-ball fighter. Hit the ball and it's yours: it flies in your colour and knocks out anyone it touches. Every hit makes it faster. One hit and you're out. Time a PERFECT swing, steal a parry, and send your friends back to the lobby.

card.name: Make It Burn
card.description: A first-person incremental game about throwing gems into a hole. Press the buzzer, push the gems into the fire and buy machines to burn more and more. Bring the gem count on the wall down to zero to open the next room.

card.name: Build to Survive
card.description: Build a car, launch it down a mountain road and let physics decide. No steering, no second chances: pick the body, engine, suspension and tyres, then watch your machine fly, crash and fall apart. Beat gold times in Challenges or race two cars side by side in Free Drive.

card.name: Nameless Fate
card.description: Follow a bamboo path into a shared temple. Sweep leaves, meditate, strike a wooden fish, or count prayer beads. Earn incense and wish slips through practice, then light a stick or write a wish by hand as other players pass through the courtyard.

card.name: Sun Smith
card.description: Help an ancient derelict repair itself. Harvest power, mine ore, fabricate components, clone colonists, and research technologies.

card.name: Guildlands
card.description: Forge, fight and trade, together. A multiplayer idle RPG that lives on your taskbar: your hero fights, mines and fishes while you work, and every piece of gear you forge shows on them. Free to play, in a shared world where players set every price.

card.name: Pawlifters!
card.description: A 2–6 player party heist game, local or online. Cute animal thieves hide in plain sight: grab the loot and blend into the crowd. Or become the guard and whack your friends with a baton — just don’t mix them up with the visitors!

card.name: Musicality
card.description: A cozy co-op music toy. Plug synths, drums and pedals together in your own little home, record takes for the neighbours, and jam with friends over Steam.

card.name: Street Football: Foul Play
card.description: Play football with no rules, solo or with up to 4 friends in local or online co-op. Customize the weather and disasters, unleash brutal tackles and super shots on your rivals, and turn every match into total chaos!

card.name: Inside the Samosbor
card.description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players set in the world of Samosbor. Explore contaminated residential blocks, find a way out, and evade monsters and anomalies. Beware of liquidators who may mistake you for the infected. Get out alive.

card.name: Corner Quest
card.description: An idle auto-battler in the corner of your screen. Your Mage fights on her own while you work. Choose her Spells, reshape them with Forms and Runes, and fight through 50+ waves in 15 Biomes.

card.name: One More Potato
card.description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

card.name: Carrot Planet
card.description: Cozy co-op incremental automation life sim for 1-8 players. Harvest an entire planet of carrots to feed the Bunny Mothership. Pick carrots, drive vehicles, automate everything, and befriend the locals. Build a massive carrot empire together!

card.name: Luck and Raid
card.description: A 1–4 player online co-op, top-down action RPG/roguelike where luck is everything. You're fluffy, and you're adorable. Earn money and get stronger. Running low on cash? Try gambling! Lost it all? Just borrow some from a friend. Your friend is broke too? Congratulations! Now the real co-op begins.

card.name: Sorted by Christmas
card.description: It’s almost Christmas and there’s a mountain of 100,000 presents still to sort. Round up your Gonk Squad for first-person co-op chaos with vacuums, black holes and Festive Dynamite. Up to 8 players, or solo.

card.name: Overcharge
card.description: Overcharge is a chaotic 2-4 player co-op platformer where holding the Energy Core for too long gets your team wiped. Catch and pass the core as you run, jump, and dodge through deadly obstacle courses. Climb the Ascension spires, overcome the Gauntlet, or build your own maps in Creative mode.

card.name: Starfuse
card.description: A cozy fireworks incremental where your upgrade tree is the night sky. Set your Shell Rack, pop drifting wish lanterns and chain bursts that relight the stars. Every place adds its own rule and a new toy, from lighthouse beams to storm clouds, until you can rekindle the dead Sun.

card.name: Saw Down
card.description: Turn a tiny robot with a saw into a machine that grinds through mountains of scrap. Gather resources, choose your upgrades, and unleash explosions, flying sawblades, and chain lightning. Grow stronger with every haul and cut your way deeper.

card.name: Put Out The Sun
card.description: Put Out The Sun is a co-op incremental game about one ridiculous job: extinguishing a star. Spit, spray and haul water as a crew of four-armed aliens, mine ice, build conveyor lines and turrets, and automate everything until the Sun finally goes dark. Play solo or with up to 6 friends.

card.name: Apartment Empire
card.description: Build your own apartment empire, one floor at a time. Design flats, collect rent, manage tenants with very different needs, and try to keep everyone happy. Meet colourful characters, uncover their stories, and discover that some residents are not entirely from around here.

card.name: Fire Up the Stadium
card.description: Fire Up the Stadium is an incremental restoration game where you bring a massive stadium back to its former glory. Restore faded seats, earn money, unlock powerful tools and upgrades, and build automated restoration machines. The more seats you restore, the faster and more powerful you become!

card.name: Just! Yell! FireBall!
card.description: Turn your voice into magic in this chaotic online PvP party game! Shout spells into your microphone, collect magic scrolls, dodge incoming attacks, and blast your rivals away in colorful arenas. Challenge friends, other players, or bots!

card.name: Bakebound
card.description: Bakebound is a short, active incremental game about harvesting a magical field that fights back. Sweep through living crops, dodge their attacks, and bake what you gather into recipes that make every trip stronger.

card.name: Treasured Carpets
card.description: Run a cozy carpet shop in an Istanbul-style bazaar. Buy rugs, wash away dirt, scrub grime, dry the fibers, and restore faded patterns. Unfold your finds for customers, match their tastes, and turn careful restoration into a thriving little showroom.

card.name: SHOVEL BRIGADE
card.description: Shovel Brigade is a free-to-play multiplayer war sandbox. Dig trenches, build bunkers, defend your camp, and survive chaotic battles with friends. Your defenses are destructible, your orders are unpredictable, and your shovel is always ready.

card.name: One Last Fish
card.description: A cozy fishing idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Catch rare fish, buy upgrades and customize your island while you study, work or relax!

card.name: Arctic Shop Simulator
card.description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

card.name: Chaos Conquest
card.description: Chaos Conquest is a casual incremental auto-battler set in a fantasy world. Mine gold, grow your army from a lone soldier into a mighty battalion, and watch as your soldiers defeat hordes of quirky enemies!
